title: Hunyango wallpaper does not update accentColor as its color cycles, leaving "Accent color from wallpaper" stale
line: With "Accent color from wallpaper", the accent color now follows Hunyango's background each time it settles on a new color, instead of staying on the first one.
explanation: The desktop computes the accent color by sampling the wallpaper, but only when the wallpaper says its accent color changed. Hunyango animates its background through a new random color every 30 seconds and never signalled anything, so the accent was sampled once and then stayed stale. The wallpaper now emits accentColorChanged each time the animation reaches its new color (also after "Randomize Wallpaper Color"), so the desktop samples it again.

commits.message:
wallpapers/hunyango: update accent color when the color changes

The accent color taken from the wallpaper was only computed once, so it
stayed on the first color while Hunyango kept cycling through new ones.
Have it recomputed every time the background settles on a new color.

BUG: 519981

media.caption: Master: over 90 s the wallpaper goes purple, orange, green while AccentColor in kdeglobals stays 220,100,206
With the fix: AccentColor follows the wallpaper (green, magenta, blue) as each new color is reached

review.text: Clean, minimal, and idiomatic QML fix: ColorProvider emits colorReached() once each ColorAnimation finishes before starting the next cycle, and main.qml connects to it to emit root.accentColorChanged(). This lets Plasma re-sample the wallpaper's accent color once per 30-second cycle (and after Randomize Wallpaper Color) using the standard extraction path without per-frame kdeglobals writes or writes when accentColorFromWallpaper is disabled, and the before/after verification clearly demonstrates the fix.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal, and idiomatic QML fix: ColorProvider emits colorReached() once each ColorAnimation finishes before starting the next cycle, and main.qml connects to it to emit root.accentColorChanged(). This lets Plasma re-sample the wallpaper's accent color once per 30-second cycle (and after Randomize Wallpaper Color) using the standard extraction path without per-frame kdeglobals writes or writes when accentColorFromWallpaper is disabled, and the before/after verification clearly demonstrates the fix.

Correct cause: Hunyango never signals WallpaperItem.accentColorChanged, so the desktop samples the accent once. Emitting it from the singleton ColorProvider's ScriptAction (when the animation reaches its target, also after Randomize) follows the same pattern the Image wallpaper already uses (ImageStackView calls wallpaperInterface.accentColorChanged() to trigger a resample) and avoids per-frame kdeglobals writes. The after composite and logged AccentColor values show the accent tracking each new color, and the regression notes cover the setting-off case. Small, in the right repo, and the commit message matches the patch; mentioning the 30 s system-wide recolor in the MR text is enough.
